image_prompt.text: A large bright blue lobby platform with glowing neon edges at the centre of the map, where players spawn and gather before setting off along the course

A chain of colourful platforms running outward from the central lobby through at least twelve stages of increasing difficulty, spaced about 6-10 studs apart and gaining a little height with every stage

Red, orange and yellow jumping blocks across the early stages, floating yellow neon-outlined spheres to leap between, alternating left-right purple and pink zigzag platforms, and a bright green spiral staircase of stepped platforms climbing upward
Narrow cyan balance-beam walkways crossed on foot for a balance challenge stage
Flat gold and yellow checkpoint marker platforms set into the course every three to four stages
A large golden victory platform at the far end of the course with a raised trophy-like centrepiece
Bright, vivid colours throughout, the sections progressing in a rainbow order from the blue lobby to the golden finish

layout_placement.text: Respawn points on the gold checkpoint pads every three to four stages, so a fall returns the player to the last pad instead of the lobby
The end reward area on the golden victory platform, where players who finish all twelve stages collect the payoff

notes: Classic Obby preset taken with its own shape, but obstacle-moving dropped: the prompt enumerates its sections and none of them rotate, convey, swing or slide, so carrying it through would instruct the image model to build obstacles the user did not ask for.

obstacle-climb added on top of the preset for the narrow cyan balance beams, and social-hub and winner-zone added for the lobby spawn platform and the golden trophy platform, none of which the preset covers.
hazard-kill deliberately not taken: failure in this course is falling off it, and nothing described is contact-lethal.

Close shape call. The course gains height every stage (CourseHeight, default 3) and one section is a spiral staircase, which reads toward course-terraced, but the prompt describes a long course extending outward from a central lobby platform, so course-flat with gentle per-stage rise. The spiral section stacks steps above each other locally; if it is built as a true wrapping ascent rather than a switchback, that one section could self-overlap and would want a look.
Stated platform spacing of 6-10 studs sits inside the P6 horizontal limit, and the 3-stud per-stage rise sits inside the vertical limit, so the requested course is generatable as written.

The requested editable attributes (PlatformSpacing 8, PlatformSize 6, CourseHeight 3, Difficulty 1) and the 'all parts anchored' requirement are build and scripting parameters rather than layout geometry; the handoff cannot carry them, but the generator should honour the spacing and rise figures above.
